verdict.rationale: Pulumi describes itself as open source (pulumi-docs-28, GitHub repo). Its DIY backend keeps state in object storage you manage, such as S3, Azure Blob or GCS, so it can run without Pulumi Cloud (pulumi-docs-4, pulumi-docs-23). The pricing page lists 'Self-hosting available', and a community user confirms a self-managed state option. One dated community comment says Pulumi only works by calling the 'mothership', but it is vague and contradicted by the documented DIY backend, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: detailed docs for self-hosting the Pulumi Cloud service itself (deployment, features, licensing), explicit air-gapped guidance, hands-on independent corroboration of a fully self-hosted setup.
